summary: Read all 17 Chinese units and checked all ten temporal/hint items and all three extracted individuals. Yao, Shun and Yu occur in an explicit retrospective appeal to the ancient sage-kings. No birth, death, age or numbered year for these people is supplied. Qualitative legendary antiquity is appropriate; Qing reign references belong to fiscal history, not to these figures. This is chronology approval only, not a full extraction or translation certification.
